text:
Sam (CS): Quick capture from today's Concierge Health check with Solara — top feedback items and potential renewal signal. They raised: 1) ask for per-route spend caps (they run large nightly embedding jobs), 2) they'd like more granular retry/error context surfaced in Console (trace IDs + sample payload), 3) observed embeddings recall drop on long multi-section reports, and 4) a short self-serve checklist for tuning and chunking.

Rita - PM: good notes. Can we quantify how many customers have flagged the embedding recall issue? Also want one concrete reproducible payload before we spike.

Sam (CS): uploaded anonymized sample to CS-7801 and pasted the minimal payload they gave: ```{"report_id":"SOL-11","chars":8600,"notes":"OCR'd lab reports + scanned tables"}``` They said similarity results fell off after ~6.5k tokens.

Leo (Support): I pulled related tickets: INC-3510, INC-3544, INC-3599. That's 4 accounts in last 6 weeks mentioning "low-recall" on long docs. Attaching samples to CS-7801 now.

Gwen (Eng): initial hunch = chunking + noisy OCR. If someone confirms the sample is ok I can run a quick repro (2-3 days). Interim recommendation if true: use 1k-2k token chunks with 10-25% overlap + simple header/footer stripping.

Mira (Docs): I can draft a one-page tuning checklist (chunk sizes, overlap, basic OCR cleanup, example curl + SDK snippet). Low effort — can ship same week.

Sam (CS): csbot recorded: "customer_signal: Solara - feature_ask/CS-7801" link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-7801

csbot: New customer signal recorded: CS-7801 (Solara). Priority: candidate.

Rita - PM: prioritization suggestion: 1) per-route spend caps (pilot offering; commercial impact), 2) retry/error trace improvements (observability), 3) embeddings repro + guidance (engineering spike), 4) publish checklist (docs). Agree?

Leo (Support): agree. I'll add severity tags: Solara -> revenue-risk; INC-3599 -> ux-annoyance. Also will surface the repeat-offender count in groom.

Gwen (Eng): I'll own the repro spike. If I can reproduce with the Solara sample, estimate 3 days for experiments + a short writeup. If it's model encoding behaviour rather than chunking, longer.

Mira (Docs): I'll have a draft checklist by EOD Thursday. Will include a small section: "if you see recall drop after X tokens, try these interim steps."

Sam (CS): drafted customer note: "Hi Lee — thanks for the call. We're opening a short pilot to explore per-route spend caps and an engineering spike to investigate the embedding recall. We'll share a quick tuning checklist this week and follow up with timelines after the spike. — Sam"

Rita - PM: action items: Gwen -> repro (owner). Mira -> docs checklist. Leo -> attach tickets + surface counts. Sam -> customer comms + pilot coordination. I'll schedule a 15-min groom tomorrow to scope the route-cap UI and billing metrics.

csbot: Label update: CS-7801 tagged [revenue-risk, candidate].

Gwen (Eng): will post initial experiment notes in CS-7801 when I start. If I'm blocked I'll ping here.

Sam (CS): thanks all. If anyone thinks we should deprioritize the checklist in favor of the pilot, call it out now.

Rita - PM: keep checklist + spike parallel; checklist is low-effort and protects customers. :+1:

Leo (Support): noted. Posting attachments in the ticket now.

Sam (CS): closing loop — scheduling groom for 10am PT tomorrow and linking CS-7801 in the invite.

Rita - PM: thanks team — good momentum.
